text:
Lina: Quick note from the migration smoke test: a bunch of internal anchors and code blocks lost metadata. Example: `### Token refresh` now has anchor `token_refresh` but some old refs use `token-refresh`. Also several fenced blocks lost language tags, which breaks the copy button on the site.
Sam: I saw the same on /guides/sdk/quickstart. The converter dropped the language on fenced blocks in a few paths. Copy button expects a language class.
Marc: We should avoid manual regex fixes across the repo. Proposed plan: 1) run a dry-run script that heuristically re-tags empty fences (python/js/bash) and unwraps HTML wrappers; 2) produce a fragment-redirects.yaml mapping dashed/underscored variants; 3) add a docs-ci check to fail on empty-language fences.
Tess: I can open a small PR with the retagger script in scripts/fix_fence_langs.py and a generator for fragment redirects. The retagger will run in --dry-run mode first and print candidate files.
Lina: Good. Also add a unit test that ensures each heading yields both dash and underscore variants in the redirect map so linkcheck stops flaking.
Sam: I'll add the docs-ci job and wire the redirect file into our redirect plugin. If the dry-run looks good we'll apply and run a full linkcheck.
Marc: One more gotcha: headings with inline code or emojis produce odd slugs. The redirect generator should skip complex headings and we should surface them for manual review.
Tess: PR #4250 created: scripts + data/fragment-redirects.yaml (dry-run entries). Tagging @lina @sam for review.
Deploy-bot: docs-ci job 10500 queued
Deploy-bot: docs-ci job 10500 succeeded
Lina: Thanks everyone. After merge, let's run the GA-driven top-50 inbound URL smoke test before we flip the site. :thumbsup:
